name: @stewardmd/capacitor-vision-ocr
description: On-device text recognition via Apple Vision (VNRecognizeTextRequest) on iOS. On Android, readDigits() via the on-device DigitReader TFLite model (CRNN-CTC). Both platforms: startPdfJob() and friends read a whole scanned PDF in the background (iOS Vision, Android ML Kit). Nothing leaves the device.
author: StewardMD
